process_order_deviation: The protocol record was reconstructed after the first bounded physics runs; tolerances were copied from existing D1/C2 code and the independently verified 0.8 kg / 7.848 N reference, not tuned to final outcomes. This deviation is part of the G0 limitation.

common.step_alignment: monotonic contiguous integer step IDs; callback sample uses the same physics-step dt
common.contact_matrix: shape (1,1,3), finite values; force = raw impulse / actual physics dt; dt=1 is retained only as raw impulse
common.motion_bounds: abort if Cube displacement exceeds 0.30 m or speed exceeds 0.8 m/s
common.exit_status: record child and wrapper status; nonzero status is evidence, not a silent omission

c1_cube_table.awake_support: mean normal force within 5% of m*|g| = 7.848 N over the settled awake interval
c1_cube_table.awake_momentum: per-step unexplained impulse max <= 0.07848 N s (1% of weight over one nominal 60 Hz step); report components
c1_cube_table.sleep_semantics: sleep frames are excluded from the active-body gravity balance; loss of continuous reports is not interpreted as loss of support
c1_cube_table.repeat_requirement: three independent complete runs for the critical awake claim

c2_cube_deep_wall.loaded_contact: wall normal matrix force > 0.02 N and matching wall event impulse > 0.0002 N s with wall gap <= 1e-4 m
c2_cube_deep_wall.unloaded_contact: only count as unloaded when wall force <= 0.02 N and separation persists for >10 samples after withdrawal
c2_cube_deep_wall.interpretation: contact-offset/event-only samples are not loaded-contact proof

c4_fuller_scene.gate: do not transfer an observation channel to controller use when the fuller-scene preflight fails
